sourceText:
Chicken Adobo
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, February 11, 2010 - 2:50pm

Ingredients




cup white wine vinegar
4 garlic cloves minced
2 tablespoons soy sauce
2 bay leaves
teaspoon ground black pepper
4 boneless chicken breast halves
pound ripe tomatoes diced
2 green onions thinly sliced
cup water
Freshly cooked rice

Preparation

1 Combine white wine vinegar, minced garlic, soy sauce, bay leaves and ground black pepper in large bowl. Add chicken breast halves and turn to coat. Cover chicken and refrigerate at least 4 hours turning occasionally. (Can be prepared up to 1 day ahead.) 2 Combined diced tomatoes and green onions in small bowl. Season with salt and pepper. (Can be prepared 4 hours ahead. Cover and refrigerate.) 3 Transfer chicken mixture to heavy medium skillet. Add 1/4 cup water. 4 Simmer over medium heat until chicken is cooked through, turning occasionally about 12 minutes. Season to taste with salt and pepper. 5 Mound cooked rice on platter. Arrange chicken over rice. Top chicken with tomato and onion mixture. Serve, passing cooking liquid separately as sauce. 6 Serves 4.
